goal: Deliver a production-grade VII management and reporting repair, public review navigation repair, canonical world control and business-page reliability fix, publish it and verify the exact release.

intent_model.literal_request: Do not miss any text or image; repair review navigation, WhatsApp/phone/bookings/reviews reporting, reporting filters, Biz conversions, admin content controls, whole-world activation, pending-page handling and Worker 1102, publish and rerun QA excluding accessibility and typography.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Adir can trust one operational control center and the public site remains fast, stable and reversible after updates.
likely_rejections: Only UI changed while data remains stale
Metrics inflate intent into completed outcomes
A world toggle leaks on unmapped surfaces
Production differs from the tested candidate
Any supplied requirement or image is omitted

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory the complete affected family and do not silently narrow the request.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Every family item needs evidence, blocker or explicit exclusion.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Deployment is authorized only after local gates and must be followed by exact production verification.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Candidate identity, rollback and deployed natural-destination evidence are mandatory.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: One trustworthy control center shows what happened, what is only intent, what converted and what needs action.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose period, date basis, world, supplier or business.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Open the matching leads, bookings, reviews, content or world-control work surface.
deferred_complexity: raw personal contact rows are exposed only on role-protected drill-downs
supplier failure diagnostics remain behind operational detail

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co business pages and authenticated /admin routes

facts.claim: The current source persists WhatsApp lead details only after the upstream lead service accepts the request.
The current business report has only 1, 7 and 30 day presets, local event aggregates and a separate per-business conversions panel.
The supplied production screenshot shows Cloudflare Error 1102 on vacation-2566.
A fresh probe returned 200 in about 4 seconds with roughly 818 KB HTML.

assumptions.claim: The authenticated deployment environment still has the required D1 binding and BizOnline token.
assumptions.validation: Run authorized production reads and fail closed without exposing secrets.

in_scope: persisted and reportable WhatsApp and phone actions
complete world activation control and surface map
invariants: No intent event is labeled as a completed call, message or booking
No raw customer details leak from unauthorized routes
Existing booking, gallery, room, breadcrumb, search, pricing, map and contact behavior remains
World off preserves data and is reversible
Only the frozen tested candidate is published

requirements.statement: The full rating row activates and focuses the actual reviews section.
WhatsApp details and phone actions are persisted and visible with truthful status semantics.
Authorized administration shows leads, phone events, local bookings, reviews and supplier-verified conversions in coherent reports.
Reports support from/till, activity/opening versus arrival date, world, supplier and business filters and matching export.
Each world can be disabled and restored across every mapped public surface.
Content editing and pending/301-backed page workflows are complete and understandable.
The vacation-2566 business route no longer reproduces Worker 1102 and its critical rendering cost is reduced.
The exact candidate, including the previously committed last-minute page, is published with rollback identity and post-deploy QA.

acceptance_checks.setup: A business page with ratings and reviews on desktop and mobile.
acceptance_checks.action: Activate anywhere in the rating summary row.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The reviews section becomes the navigated/focused destination and URL behavior is stable after reload.

acceptance_checks.setup: A non-destructive synthetic fixture is inserted through an isolated test database or approved test harness.
acceptance_checks.action: Complete lead/contact persistence then reload the protected report.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All supplied fields and status semantics are retrievable once, without duplicate or outcome inflation.

acceptance_checks.setup: Authorized report data spans multiple dates, worlds, suppliers and places.
acceptance_checks.action: Change date basis, range and dimensions and export CSV.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Server result, visible totals, rows and export agree; VII and Biz bookings have distinct columns.

acceptance_checks.action: Request management aggregates and personal drill-downs.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Anonymous access is denied; authorized aggregates and drill-downs return only their designed data.

acceptance_checks.setup: A reversible test world state in an isolated database.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: It disappears and returns across the mapped family without deleting content or leaking stale links.

acceptance_checks.setup: Redirect-only, draft, review, scheduled and published pages.
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect and operate the management views.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each state has an explicit reason, destination and valid next action; editable homepage fields persist and reflect.

acceptance_checks.setup: Repeated cold and warm public probes for vacation-2566 and representative other worlds.
acceptance_checks.action: Load each within a bounded sample.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No 1102; all return 200; critical response cost is measured and improved or a precise external limit is recorded.

acceptance_checks.setup: Frozen candidate, prior public release and deployment authorization.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish once, verify terminal success, then test exact public routes and release identity.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The public release matches the candidate, rollback is known and changed/preserved flows pass post-deploy QA.

authorization_boundary: Implementation and publication are authorized. Real customer communications, calls, reviews, bookings, payments, destructive data operations, accessibility and typography audits are excluded.
